description: Section 57 (4) - WA Mining Act (DMIRS-044) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Areas defined under Section 57(4) of the Mining Act 1978 as being those lands that due to the intensity of mining activity are exempt from being the subject of an Exploration License. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Its tags are Exempt, Exploration Licence, Minerals, Mining, Section 57 Mining Act. It offers 4 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, shp kmz tab, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
